The Data Paradox

Salesforce creates events for everything. Treat a simple CEP correction with the same priority as a contract closure generates unnecessary costs and operational inefficiency.

The Chaos (Noise)

Typo Fix Log Update Cold Lead Edit Profile Time Log

High Computation Cost & Latency

Solution (Signal)

Deal Meta Beat Opportunity > 500 k

Focus on Optimized Value & Processing

Solution Architecture

Salesforce Event-Drive Data Flow to Seller

Smart Filtering

"Let's not boil the ocean, just tea water."

We use standard rules in EventBridge to discard irrelevant events before even invoking functions Lambda, reducing costs drastically.

Unified Optimization

"The Logic of Amazon Delivery."

There's no point in Lead being hot if he's two hours away.

Score = (Potencial) / (Custo Deslocamento)

Feedback Loop

"The Seller trains the Machine."

Route refusal data (e.g. "bad transit") are stored in S3 and used to retrain the ML models, creating a system that evolves.

NEXT LEVEL

In addition to Optimization: Learning with LLMs

Integration with Amazon Bedrock to interpret natural language. The system reads the seller's free feedback:

"I don't stop at Augusta Street Friday afternoon, it's impossible to park."

...and automatically creates temporal block rules for that region.

Real-time sales intelligence

An architecture that combines Salesforce and AWS to take Real-time sales intelligence to the commercial team: events and data processed at the time became actionable signals, increasing the efficiency of the sales operation.

  • Real time — events processed on time, not in reports of the following day.
  • Salesforce + AWS — CRM as a commercial brain, the cloud as a data engine.
  • Activable signals — the next best action at the right time.
  • Commercial efficiency — less manual effort, more conversion.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What is real-time sales intelligence?

It is the ability to turn sales events and data into actionable signals at the time they happen, rather than rely on delayed reports. Combining Salesforce and AWS, the team gets the next best action on time.

How do Salesforce and AWS complement each other?

Salesforce is the client's commercial brain (CRM, processes and context); AWS provides the real-time data and event engine (ingestion, processing and AI). Together they deliver commercial decisions based on current data.

What's the gain for the commercial operation?

More efficiency: less manual work of mining data, automatic prioritization of the best opportunities and action at the time of higher probability of conversion.
